Poisson’s Ratio: When a wire or a rod is deformed using a force, it either lengthens or contracts, resulting in a decrease or an increase in diameter. The change in diameter compared to the original diameter is called lateral strain, while the change in length compared to the original length is called longitudinal strain. Hence, the ratio of the lateral strain to the longitudinal strain within the elastic limit is called Poisson’s ratio, σ.
